# Data Structure (자료구조)

> Korean-language course materials from Pusan National University: lecture slides (PDF), interactive topic pages, and concept-check problem sets.

Instructor: [YongKyung Oh](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/people/)

## Lectures

- [Structure and Cost](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/00.%20Intro.pdf) (PDF)
- [Data Abstraction](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/01.%20Data%20Abstraction.pdf) (PDF): [Data Abstraction](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/data-abstraction.html), [Operations And Semantics](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/operations-and-semantics.html), [ADT Specifications](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/adt-specifications.html), [Choosing An ADT](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/choosing-an-adt.html), [Concept check: Data Abstraction and ADTs](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/data-abstraction-and-adts.html)
- [Interfaces](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/02.%20Interfaces.pdf) (PDF): [Interface And Specification](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/interface-and-specification.html), [Representation And Work](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/representation-and-work.html), [Python Objects](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/python-objects.html), [Two Implementations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/two-implementations.html), [Concept check: Interfaces and Implementations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/interfaces-and-implementations.html)
- [Measuring Cost](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/03.%20Measuring%20Cost.pdf) (PDF): [Timing A Run](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/timing-a-run.html), [Counting Operations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/counting-operations.html), [Loops And Input Size](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/loops-and-input-size.html), [Python Operations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/03.%20Measuring%20Cost/python-operations.html), [Concept check: Running Time and Operation Counts](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/measuring-cost.html)
- [Reasoning About Growth](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/04.%20Reasoning%20About%20Growth.pdf) (PDF): [Growth Rate](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/04.%20Reasoning%20About%20Growth/growth-rate.html), [Asymptotic Bounds](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/04.%20Reasoning%20About%20Growth/asymptotic-bounds.html), [Reading Code As A Function](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/04.%20Reasoning%20About%20Growth/reading-code-as-a-function.html), [Best Worst And Average](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/04.%20Reasoning%20About%20Growth/best-worst-and-average.html), [Concept check: Growth Rates and Asymptotic Notation](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/asymptotic-growth.html)
- [Storing Elements in a Row](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row.pdf) (PDF): [Contiguous Storage](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/contiguous-storage.html), [Backing Array](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/backing-array.html), [Cost Of Shifting](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/cost-of-shifting.html), [What Arrays Are Good For](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/05.%20Storing%20Elements%20in%20a%20Row/what-arrays-are-good-for.html), [Concept check: Arrays](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/arrays.html)
- [When the Array Fills Up](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up.pdf) (PDF): [Capacity And Resize](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/capacity-and-resize.html), [Amortized Cost](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/amortized-cost.html), [Inside Python Lists](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/inside-python-lists.html), [Circular Arrays](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/06.%20When%20the%20Array%20Fills%20Up/circular-arrays.html), [Concept check: Dynamic Arrays](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/dynamic-arrays.html)
- [Giving Up Contiguity](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/07.%20Giving%20Up%20Contiguity.pdf) (PDF): [Singly Linked Nodes](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/07.%20Giving%20Up%20Contiguity/singly-linked-nodes.html), [References And Aliasing](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/07.%20Giving%20Up%20Contiguity/references-and-aliasing.html), [Concept check: Linked-List Representation](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/linked-lists.html)
- [Walking the References](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/08.%20Walking%20the%20References.pdf) (PDF): [Linked List Traversal](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/08.%20Walking%20the%20References/linked-list-traversal.html), [Linked List Search](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/08.%20Walking%20the%20References/linked-list-search.html), [Linked List Updates](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/08.%20Walking%20the%20References/linked-list-updates.html), [Concept check: Linked-List Operations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/linked-list-operations.html)
- [Links Both Ways](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/09.%20Links%20Both%20Ways.pdf) (PDF): [Doubly Linked Lists](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/09.%20Links%20Both%20Ways/doubly-linked-lists.html), [Sentinel Nodes](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/09.%20Links%20Both%20Ways/sentinel-nodes.html), [Concept check: Doubly Linked Lists](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/doubly-linked-lists.html)
- [Same List, Different Costs](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/10.%20Same%20List%2C%20Different%20Costs.pdf) (PDF): [Arrays Vs Linked Lists](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/10.%20Same%20List%2C%20Different%20Costs/arrays-vs-linked-lists.html), [Operation Mix](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/10.%20Same%20List%2C%20Different%20Costs/operation-mix.html), [Concept check: Arrays and Linked Lists](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/arrays-and-linked-lists.html)
- [Last In, First Out](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/11.%20Last%20In%2C%20First%20Out.pdf) (PDF): [Stack ADT](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/11.%20Last%20In%2C%20First%20Out/stack-adt.html), [Stack Expression Processing](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/11.%20Last%20In%2C%20First%20Out/stack-expression-processing.html), [Call Stack](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/11.%20Last%20In%2C%20First%20Out/call-stack.html), [Concept check: Stacks](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/stacks.html)
- [First In, First Out](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/12.%20First%20In%2C%20First%20Out.pdf) (PDF): [Queue ADT](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/12.%20First%20In%2C%20First%20Out/queue-adt.html), [Queue Simulations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/12.%20First%20In%2C%20First%20Out/queue-simulations.html), [Deque ADT](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/12.%20First%20In%2C%20First%20Out/deque-adt.html), [Concept check: Queues and Deques](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/problem-sets/queues-and-deques.html)
